ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
relnote reads the commits in a git range, groups Conventional Commits
into Features, Fixes, and other sections, and prints Markdown release
notes ready for a GitHub release. It can also prepend a Keep a Changelog
section to CHANGELOG.md and suggest the next SemVer tag. No dependencies
beyond Python and git.
about.summary: Turn a git range into clean GitHub release notes.

script: git -c user.name=test -c user.email=test@example.com commit -q --allow-empty -m "feat: add widget"
git -c user.name=test -c user.email=test@example.com commit -q --allow-empty -m "fix: correct widget"
python -c "s = open('notes.md', encoding='utf-8').read(); assert '### Features' in s and 'add widget' in s, s"

name: relnote
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: relnote
  version: "0.3.2"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/loki-inu/relnote/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8494ff181d5f25277f8a24676c5a36da60356d1cde6ecbc11b7ee2acabbf7ab3

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - relnote = relnote.__main__:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=61
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - git

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - relnote
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - git
    script:
      - relnote --version
      - relnote --help
      - git init -q demo
      - cd demo
      - 'git -c user.name=test -c user.email=test@example.com commit -q --allow-empty -m "feat: add widget"'
      - 'git -c user.name=test -c user.email=test@example.com commit -q --allow-empty -m "fix: correct widget"'
      - relnote --output notes.md
      - python -c "s = open('notes.md', encoding='utf-8').read(); assert '### Features' in s and 'add widget' in s, s"
      - relnote --next-version

about:
  homepage: https://loki-inu.github.io/relnote/
  repository: https://github.com/loki-inu/relnote
  documentation: https://loki-inu.github.io/relnote/
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Turn a git range into clean GitHub release notes.
  description: |
    relnote reads the commits in a git range, groups Conventional Commits
    into Features, Fixes, and other sections, and prints Markdown release
    notes ready for a GitHub release. It can also prepend a Keep a Changelog
    section to CHANGELOG.md and suggest the next SemVer tag. No dependencies
    beyond Python and git.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - loki-inu
